routes.title: Regular 600-cell spatial carrier
routes.claim: The fixed spatial carrier is the regular 600-cell boundary complex, a finite triangulation of S^3 with f-vector (120,720,1200,600).
routes.scope: Combinatorial spatial carrier only; this does not derive continuum spacetime or a fourth spatial dimension.

routes.title: Lorentzian Regge-plus-dust slab action
routes.claim: The fixed zero-Lambda Lorentzian Regge action with its boundary term and conserved homogeneous dust has a reproducible complete-action implementation on the 600-cell slab.
routes.scope: Classical fixed-carrier action; matter content, its mass scale and a tick duration are inputs or separate questions.

routes.title: Exact finite-height one-slab solutions
routes.claim: The reduced homogeneous canonical equations admit classified nonzero positive-height one-slab solutions on a derived incoming interval.
routes.scope: Homogeneous tetrahedral-frustum sector on the fixed 600-cell carrier.
hypotheses: homogeneous edge lengths and global dust
positive physical-height and Lorentzian branch gates

routes.title: Two-slab relation is not globally single-valued
routes.claim: At the frozen incoming state v=3/2 the first outgoing canonical state has two distinct physical second slabs; the action and stated inequalities alone do not define a unique tick.
routes.scope: Representative homogeneous composition under the frozen physical gates; this does not exclude an additional selector or nonhomogeneous resolution.
routes.kill_scope: A deterministic homogeneous tick derived from the frozen action plus positivity, causality and real-branch membership alone.
routes.reopen_condition: Supply and preregister an independently justified selector, or show that nonhomogeneous/refined equations remove the branch ambiguity.

routes.title: Standard local selectors do not choose a branch
routes.claim: Causality, future orientation, real action-branch membership and local Legendre regularity accept both second-slab branches at v=3/2.
routes.scope: Only the explicitly tested standard local selectors; it is not a theorem that every conceivable selector fails.
routes.kill_scope: Repairing the branch ambiguity using only the four tested local conditions.
routes.reopen_condition: Introduce a new physical selector with independent motivation and a preregistered falsification test.

routes.title: Future extendibility selects branch B structurally
routes.claim: Branch A has no physical third slab while branch B has exactly one; the accepted branch then has unique fourth and fifth slabs.
routes.scope: Representative v=3/2 homogeneous history; future extendibility is a global admissibility criterion, not a derived local law.
hypotheses: the same action and physical root gates at later slabs

routes.title: Invariant half-strip and every finite successor
routes.claim: A rigorous invariant half-strip contains the accepted branch and gives one physical successor at every later prescribed finite step by induction.
routes.scope: The representative branch after entry into the proved scale-free region; not convergence, infinite total proper duration or completeness.
search_terms: m less than two fifths x 125

routes.title: Convergence and infinite-duration history
routes.claim: No theorem yet proves convergence to one limiting state, infinite accumulated proper duration, geodesic completeness or a unique history as a completed infinite object.
routes.scope: Distinguishes the proved successor at each finite index from stronger analytic and physical claims about the infinite history.
routes.next_test: Prove convergence and sum the proper heights with rigorous bounds, or construct a counterexample inside the invariant region.

routes.title: No universal asymptotic fixed point
routes.claim: The exact compactified map has a continuous physical fixed family at the boundary, so it does not select one universal scale ratio or endpoint.
routes.scope: The frozen scale-free homogeneous asymptotic map.
routes.kill_scope: Deriving one universal asymptotic ratio from this compactified homogeneous map alone.
routes.reopen_condition: Add a separately derived condition that breaks the continuous boundary family and test it without fitting.

routes.title: Generic incoming-state basin
routes.claim: A finite census finds 36 depth-four signatures and proves a local nonzero neighbourhood of the v=3/2 tree, but it does not classify the continuum basin or generic determinism.
routes.scope: The one-parameter incoming curve only, with a frozen finite search depth.
hypotheses: the same homogeneous action and physical gates
the local interval certificate around v=3/2
routes.next_test: Construct a rigorous continuum basin certificate only if it becomes necessary for a physical claim; another deeper finite census is not enough.

routes.title: Geometry-selected nonhomogeneous tangent carrier
routes.claim: The exact rank-240 scale-plus-strut carrier and its one-sided quadratic action are schedule robust within the frozen controls.
routes.scope: First accepted finite-height slab and first-order/nonlinear-jet carrier tests only.

routes.title: Internal stationarity leaves one homogeneous line
routes.claim: The complete internal equation map has rank 239 on the rank-240 carrier; every nonhomogeneous sector has full column rank and one homogeneous line survives.
routes.scope: The first finite-height slab and the declared rank-240 carrier.
hypotheses: all 720 diagonal and 120 pole internal equations

routes.title: Internal survivor is not a free tick
routes.claim: The sole internal survivor is exactly the homogeneous lapse-constraint tangent dC=0, and fixed incoming canonical momentum removes it.
routes.scope: The first-slab rank-240 carrier; this is not a claim of zero forced dynamics.
hypotheses: fixed incoming geometry and canonical momentum
routes.kill_scope: Interpreting the rank-239 internal kernel line as a freely propagating mode or a derived tick.
routes.reopen_condition: Change the physical carrier or boundary-data problem and derive a new kernel; do not reinterpret this line.

routes.title: First full canonical boundary tangent
routes.claim: Two mechanically different calculations construct a regular symplectic 1440-dimensional forced boundary tangent on the first accepted slab with no resolved staircase-schedule dependence.
routes.scope: One linearized slab at v=3/2; no constraint quotient, wave label or physical spectrum yet.
hypotheses: even and odd H4 staircase schedules

routes.title: Second finite-height tangent and physical two-step composition
routes.claim: The active preregistered test asks whether the accepted second slab has a regular schedule-robust canonical tangent, whether direct physical units realize the exact degree-two scale lift, and whether all four schedule compositions agree.
routes.scope: The newly derived finite-height branch B background; it deliberately does not inspect mode spectra.
hypotheses: direct normalized and physical Hessian assemblies
routes.next_test: Finish and run only the registered primary verifier; if material, freeze and run a mechanically different replication before interpreting the result.

routes.title: Older near-static two-step tangent machinery
routes.claim: The repository already contains a complete two-step 1440-dimensional canonical tangent cocycle on the older near-static background with inherited tau=0.0102.
routes.scope: Method precedent and hostile control only; its background and inherited scale are not the current finite-height branch.
hypotheses: the older published or near-static dust chain

routes.title: Older three-slice Jacobi machinery
routes.claim: The repository already derives a three-slice position-space recurrence with acceleration, background-drift and stiffness blocks on the older near-static background.
routes.scope: Method precedent only; the stiffness was not proved to be the physical spatial tensor operator and no c was derived.
hypotheses: regular elimination of the two old slab interiors
search_terms: K minus K zero K plus

routes.title: Homogeneous refinement approaches the Friedmann control
routes.claim: The fixed 600-cell, first refinement and second refinement reduce the homogeneous acceleration error from about 7.90% to 1.91% to 0.47%, with a near-factor-four pattern.
routes.scope: Three frozen refinement levels and homogeneous acceleration only; no infinite-refinement theorem or local GR result.
hypotheses: post-commit comparison with closed-dust Friedmann acceleration

routes.title: No absolute classical tick from the scale-free action
routes.claim: Global scale covariance sends every stationary solution and its canonical data into a continuous scale family; the stated classical action cannot select an absolute nonzero tick.
routes.scope: Zero-Lambda classical Regge-plus-dust action when geometrized masses scale with geometry and no external dimensionful structure is fixed.
hypotheses: all squared lengths scale by alpha^2
all geometrized masses scale by alpha
no fixed external length, mass or quantum scale
routes.kill_scope: Deriving seconds, an absolute tick or a Planck length from the scale-covariant classical action alone.
routes.reopen_condition: Derive an independent dimensionful scale-breaking structure, such as quantum input, fixed physical matter data, Lambda or boundary data, before comparing with measured units.

routes.title: Physical constraint and pseudo-constraint quotient
routes.claim: The full boundary tangents have not yet been reduced to a defensible physical phase space separating constraints, pseudo-constraints, matter modes and gauge or coordinate artefacts.
routes.scope: Nonhomogeneous perturbations on the evolving curved finite-height branch.
routes.next_test: After NH-SECOND-TANGENT passes, preregister the action-derived covectors and quotient criterion before inspecting any mode spectrum.

routes.title: Local gravitational modes and discrete wave operator
routes.claim: No physical graviton, stable anisotropic propagation law or spatial tensor-Laplacian correspondence has been derived on the finite-height branch.
routes.scope: Linearized nonhomogeneous physics after the physical constraint quotient.
hypotheses: an independently derived intrinsic spatial operator
routes.next_test: Derive the finite-height three-slice recurrence, classify its kinetic form, and compare the blind stiffness sectors with an independently fixed intrinsic spatial operator.

routes.title: Effective limiting speed
routes.claim: No value of c or lattice limiting speed has been derived; it would require a physical temporal kinetic coefficient and spatial stiffness on the same reduced modes.
routes.scope: Dimensionless lattice ratio first; conversion to measured units additionally needs scale breaking.
routes.next_test: Only after P-WAVES, form the preregistered coefficient ratio and test schedule and refinement stability without calibrating to measured c.

routes.title: G and Planck units
routes.claim: The repository derives neither Newton's constant as a prediction nor Planck length, time or mass; classical scale covariance blocks an absolute value without new dimensionful input.
routes.scope: Absolute units and coupling normalization, not the existence of the Regge action coefficient as an input convention.
hypotheses: a physical continuum or refinement limit
routes.next_test: Do not numerically search Planck values; first identify and preregister a non-fitted scale-breaking mechanism.

routes.title: Particles, masses and Standard Model
routes.claim: The active public Regge programme contains no derived particle spectrum, particle masses, gauge algebra or Standard-Model sector.
routes.scope: The current public theory; legacy fitted particle-physics material is intentionally excluded from the active tree.
hypotheses: a physically accepted local gravitational/matter phase space
routes.next_test: No active particle route is authorized by the present gravity results; open one only with its own prior-art gate and non-fitted construction.
